name: Plyometric Push-Up
description: Advanced strength bodyweight exercise performed outdoors. Emphasizes core with support from surrounding musculature.
instructions: Begin with a thorough dynamic warm-up (5–10 minutes).
Set your body for plyometric push-up with controlled posture and braced core.
Move through the full range with intent; keep tension and avoid momentum.
Breathe rhythmically: exhale on exertion, inhale on return.
Maintain alignment; stop if technique degrades.
Rest as prescribed before repeating sets.
tips: Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Control the eccentric; explode on the concentric where appropriate.
Land softly with knees tracking over toes on any jumps.
contraindications: Avoid if you have acute pain in involved joints.
Modify range or regress if form breaks down.

instructions: Begin with a thorough dynamic warm-up (5–10 minutes).
Set your body for bounding in place with controlled posture and braced core.
Move through the full range with intent; keep tension and avoid momentum.
Breathe rhythmically: exhale on exertion, inhale on return.
Maintain alignment; stop if technique degrades.
Rest as prescribed before repeating sets.
tips: Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Control the eccentric; explode on the concentric where appropriate.
Land softly with knees tracking over toes on any jumps.
contraindications: Avoid if you have acute pain in involved joints.
Modify range or regress if form breaks down.

Set your body for diamond push-up — tempo 3-1-3 with controlled posture and braced core.
Move through the full range with intent; keep tension and avoid momentum.
Breathe rhythmically: exhale on exertion, inhale on return.
Maintain alignment; stop if technique degrades.
Rest as prescribed before repeating sets.
tips: Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Control the eccentric; explode on the concentric where appropriate.
Land softly with knees tracking over toes on any jumps.
contraindications: Avoid if you have acute pain in involved joints.
Modify range or regress if form breaks down.
